reproduce.requirements: npm ci, macOS, installed native Mach-O OpenCode binary, /usr/bin/sandbox-exec. The runner enforces isolated HOME/workspace and loopback-only network.

limitations: Scripted local model replies validate transport and cancellation mechanics; no paid or real model inference.
Native acceptance ran on macOS arm64; Linux, Windows, WSL and Docker remain unqualified.
No packaged VS Code UI acceptance or elapsed endurance claim.
POSIX process metadata inspection is bounded and best-effort. If unavailable, ordinary owned-group cleanup remains. Descendants that reparent before the ownership snapshot cannot safely be inferred.
PID birth-time/group matching narrows reuse risk; ps observation and kill are separate system calls, not an atomic process-handle operation.

reusableRunnerAcceptance.scope: Installed native CLI on macOS; production provider bundled from source, scripted loopback model and isolated disposable workspace. No paid inference, packaged VS Code UI, Windows/Linux qualification or elapsed endurance.
